TOPIC 5.10
Introduction to 
Optimization Problems

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

FUN-4.B
Calculate minimum and 
maximum values in applied 
contexts or analysis of 
functions.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

FUN-4.B.1
The derivative can be used to solve optimization 
problems; that is, finding a minimum or 
maximum value of a function on a given interval.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

FUN-4
A function’s derivative can be used to understand some behaviors of the function.  

SUGGESTED SKILLS 

Connecting 
Representations

2.A
Identify common underlying 
structures in problems 
involving different contextual 
situations.
